attempts.response:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS baseline_situps
  FROM "sportathon_baseline"
),
endline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS endline_situps
  FROM "sportathon_endline"
),
improvement AS (
  SELECT 
    b."Child ID",
    b."Child Name",
    b."Sit Ups" AS baseline_situps,
    e."Sit Ups" AS endline_situps,
    e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS situp_improvement
  FROM baseline b
  JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
)
SELECT "Child Name", "situp_improvement"
FROM improvement
WHERE "situp_improvement" > 0
ORDER BY "situp_improvement" DESC
LIMIT 5;
